thread:
maria: hey team, starting tomorrow — quick heads-up: i'm trying to enroll the company Mac that arrived but MDM enrollment fails with 'bootstrap token missing'. anyone seen this?
alex-it: welcome Maria! weird, that message usually means FileVault preboot key wasn't set. did you accept the macOS setup assistant prompts and let the system restart after letting the MDM profile run?
maria: i walked through setup and restarted twice. the 'Profiles' pane shows a failed state. i can paste logs if helpful.
devex: if you can, run this and paste output:
```
sudo profiles renew -type enrollment
profiles status -type enrollment
```
that'll show the enrollment state. some Apple silicon devices require a bootstrap token from the installer image.
maria: ok running now... got `profiles: command not found` on first line. is that expected?
alex-it: ah, you're on a newer mac image where profiles is in /usr/bin/profiles — run with full path or use the MDM diagnostic in the onboarding doc. also check /var/log/mdmclient.log for errors.
it-procurement: @maria — if this was imaged by our vendor please open a ticket to imaging-team with serial number. if it's a personal machine we can't supervise it without a procurement exception.
maria: it's marked 'company' on the sticker, so i assumed imaged. i'll open a ticket.
security-bot: phishsim note: new hire accounts are included in phishing tests after 7 calendar days. Accommodation exceptions for phishing/email testing require an approved HR form + security sign-off.
hr: @maria if you need an accommodation (e.g., can't respond to simulated phishing for health reasons), file this form: https://redwood.example/hr/accommodation. We can provision a temporary opt-out window while we review.
maria: i actually can't use my phone authenticator for a couple weeks (medical appts). can we use a hardware key instead for MFA?
it-procurement: yes — we have HOT-FRAME (loaner) YubiKeys for short-term use. can ship same-day if urgent; otherwise we enroll a permanent key to your Okta profile. reply with shipping address if you want loaner.
alex-it: once you have the key, follow devex doc to register with SSO (Okta > Security > Multifactor > Add Security Key). i'll also whitelist device enrollment from your IP for the first day to reduce friction.
devex: side note on personal devices: we don't allow company data on unmanaged personal machines. If you absolutely must use a personal device temporarily, we require enrollment, FileVault on, and a signed temporary BYOD agreement — we can provision a secure VM instead which is often faster.
hr: accommodation processing for phishsim/2FA alternatives takes 48 business hours after form submission. please include any medical note if you're comfortable so we can act faster.
maria: thanks all. i'll file the imaging ticket and the accommodation form now, and ping here with ticket numbers. appreciate the quick replies.
it-procurement: noted; if you DM your address we'll queue a loaner YubiKey express shipment.
security-bot: reminder: do not disable SIP or modify kernel extensions on company devices without an approved security exception. Those are high-risk and need a documented mitigation plan.
maria: understood. filing the forms and opening ticket now — i'll update when done. thanks folks :)
